gov_311_requests.description: Synthetic sample of City of Port Alder 311 service requests created 2025-01-01 to 2026-10-31 (one row per request; open requests have no closed_at). Fictional data.

columns.name: request_id
columns.description: Tracking number of the request (historical sample ids start with SR-H).

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: When the request was received (city local time).

columns.name: closed_at
columns.description: When the request was closed; NULL while open.

columns.name: category
columns.description: Category code: POTHOLE, STREETLIGHT_OUT, MISSED_COLLECTION, BULKY_ITEM, ILLEGAL_DUMPING, GRAFFITI, TRAFFIC_SIGNAL, SIGN_DAMAGE, WATER_LEAK, TREE_DOWN, ABANDONED_VEHICLE, SIDEWALK_DAMAGE, DEAD_ANIMAL.

columns.name: department
columns.description: Owning department code: PW-STR, PW-LGT, SAN, TRN, PRK, CDE, WTR, ANS, PKE.

columns.name: channel
columns.description: Intake channel: phone, app, web, messaging, walk_in.

columns.name: sla_hours
columns.description: Target hours to close for the category and priority (311 Service Standards).

columns.name: hours_to_close
columns.description: Hours from created_at to closed_at; NULL while open.

columns.name: sla_met
columns.description: TRUE if closed within sla_hours; FALSE if closed late or still open past its due time; NULL if open and not yet due.

columns.name: is_duplicate
columns.description: TRUE if the report was merged into an existing request as a follower.

columns.name: reopened
columns.description: TRUE if the resident reopened the request after closure.

columns.name: satisfaction_score
columns.description: Post-closure survey score 1-5; NULL when the resident did not answer.
